content.title: Boca Restaurants – Fresh Seasonal Creations
content.text: the perfect neighborhood restaurant Boca is your friendly local hang-out, where everything is done with incredible passion and thoughtfulness. The street setting, sidewalk tables, and open windows provide the energy of the city, while the industrial farmhouse style and fresh seasonal creations puts you at the source of great food and drinks. ABOUT BOCA With a cozy vibe, food you crave, and heartfelt hospitality, Boca is your kind of place - where everyone recognizes you and knows how much you matter. Relax and enjoy the comfortable industrial farmhouse design while great music and engaging conversation surround you. An everyday upscale restaurant where you can be yourself and enjoy great fresh seasonal creations while we work thoughtfully to make even the most simple moments extraordinary. OUR MENU With a fresh and seasonal approach to the classics, Boca is the food you love handcrafted with the freshest ingredients into dishes you will crave. The perfect salad, amazing flatbreads, the best PEI mussels, the tastiest locally raised cheeseburger you’ve ever had, simply prepared fresh fish, the daily butcher’s cut and desserts ranging from luscious to decadent. There is something to pair with every mood. IF YOU POSSESS A SERVANT’S HEART Our team members work together to provide our guests with joyful and heartfelt hospitality—leaving lasting memories and compelling our guests to want to return and to share their experiences.
